issue.title: Add Lean deltas to merge-train member commit titles

labels.name: infrastructure
labels.description: Foundational definitions, shared APIs, or supporting layers

issue.body:
<!-- mipstarre-issue-key: merge-train-member-lean-delta-20260918 -->
The owner requires the Lean line delta in every merge-commit title on main.
PR #558 implemented that requirement for ordinary PR merges under #557.
The newly merged train in #507 does not yet apply it to member merge commits.

At main commit7bc9bf889712a736451dbc92685d0f3da8097a9b,
`local/bin/pr_train.py:125` commits each member with only
`Merge PR #<number> into reviewed train`. Those commits become part of main
when the train publishes, so their subjects would omit the required delta.

Before the first live train:

- Reuse the existing `pr_merge.lean_line_delta` and
  `pr_merge.merge_commit_title` conventions for each train member.
- Measure each member's contribution against the immediately preceding
  accepted train state, including any merge resolution. Preserve the
  existing handling of zero delta and measurement failure and the title's
  closing-reference sanitization. Do not invent a second counting policy.
- Add focused fixtures for additions/deletions, zero delta, and sequential
  members whose deltas must not become cumulative. Verify the subject of
  every merge commit that the published train would add to main.
- Preserve member heads, tree contents, topology, claim lifetime, review
  gates, leased transport and post-push checks.

This is a narrow integration of the already accepted title policy into the
already reviewed train. It does not reopen the owner's transport contract
or require a server-side member predicate. MAIN has not run a live train;
the daemon remains the only publisher of merges. Approved580 and587 are
queued for train use after this fix and daemon scheduling.

evidence: local/bin/pr_train.py:125 member merge subject has no Lean delta; no commit-msg hook exists
owner_policy: Every first-parent merge commit on main carries Lean delta; existing ordinary formatter delivered by558
